items.title: Activity state tracking
items.text: Windows and panes now support `idle`, `busy`, and `needs_input` states via the new `+set-state` command. State is aggregated across panes and exposed as a title suffix and accessibility attribute, so window managers and automation can react to what's happening inside.

items.title: OSC 7777 activity reporting
items.text: Processes can set their own activity state via the `\033]7777;<state>\007` escape sequence, no CLI call needed.

items.title: Send keys to panes
items.text: The new `+send-keys` command writes text and key sequences (Enter, Ctrl-C, etc.) directly to a named pane's PTY, enabling full scripted interaction.

items.title: Read terminal output
items.text: The new `+read` command captures the last N lines of scrollback from a named pane, printed to stdout for piping or inspection.

items.title: Environment variable passthrough
items.text: `+new-window` and `+split` now accept `--env` to inject environment variables into the spawned process.

items.title: Shell-aware command execution
items.text: `--command` on IPC commands now wraps in the user's login shell with profile loaded, so aliases, PATH, and shell config work out of the box.

items.title: Declarative pane layout
items.text: The new `+rearrange` command lets you restructure pane layouts without tearing down and rebuilding.

items.title: Process exit tracking
items.text: `+list` output now includes `exit_code` for each pane, so you can detect when commands have finished and whether they succeeded.
